query: Top 10 customers by total balance

sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(a.balance) as total_balance
FROM customers c
JOIN accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC
LIMIT 10
